# Outlaws of Appalachia Challenge Event: All Rewards

![Outlaws of Appalachia Challenge Event: All Rewards](/uploads/496_blog-teaser-template.jpg)

![skywalka](/public/avatar_skywalka_fo76_nuka_knights_variant2_square_white-black.png) 

**[Update April 23, 2025]** New note: Challenges also possible in PA **[Update April 22, 2025]** Important note about receiving rewards updated

The next challenge event is just around the corner. “**Outlaws of Appalachia**” is the name of the new challenge event.

Current dates:

*Insider Info: This challenge and the rewards are not currently available in the game's live data. Therefore, Bethesda announced the mid-season patch for Tuesday today. The challenge and various bug fixes will be included there.*

## Free Challenge Item

As always, completing the challenges requires a new piece of equipment. In this case it is the "**Money Bag Backpack**" which you will receive for free ~~in the Atom Shop~~ from the start of the challenge in the new mini-season**.

*Note:* It is now possible to **complete** these **Challenges** in Power Armor**. There is a new function in the challenges called "WornInOrOutOfPowerArmor", which detects when you wear the backpack before entering the PA and counts it towards the challenges.

## All Event Challenges

**Week 1**

- Outlaws of Appalachia: Complete Week 1 Challenges. (7)
- Collect a pack or carton of cigarettes while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (5)
- Collect pre-war money while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (76)
- Craft a Molotov Cocktail while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (15)
- Salvage Scrap to make Silver while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (5)
- Kill an enemy while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (500)
- Kill a human while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (76)
- Pick a lock while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (1)

**Week 2**

- Outlaws of Appalachia: Complete Week 2 Challenges. (7)
- Collect Stimpaks or Chems while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (76)
- Collect a Cigar Box while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (3)
- Drink an alcoholic beverage while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (20)
- Craft ballistic ammunition while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (760)
- Destroy a Protectron while having the Money Bag Backpack equipped. (50)
- Salvage scrap to make gold while equipped with the Money Bag Backpack. (5)
- Hack a terminal while you have the Money Bag Backpack equipped. (3)

**Challenge**

- Outlaws of Appalachia: Complete Week 1 and Week 2 Challenges. (2)

## Event Rewards

**Update (04/22/2025):** The challenge events are now integrated into the season as a “**Mini-Season**”. To receive the rewards you only need the tickets for the season. So if you have enough tickets, you can unlock all rewards right from the start. You can also use the tickets you earn for the mini season in the regular season.

~~Unfortunately, the challenge is not completely stored on the current PTS, so you cannot currently see exactly which reward will be awarded for which challenge. This information will be updated here in the post as soon as the update is available.~~

**Duffel bag full of cash**

Present in your C.A.M.P. your greed and your stolen riches with this duffel bag full of cash!

CAMP Decoration: Floor Decor

**piggy bank**

Now you can have pig even if you don't have bottle caps!

CAMP Decoration: Floor Decor

**Investigation Board**

With this investigation board you can track down even the most notorious criminals from the wasteland's underworld!

CAMP decoration: wall decoration
